title: Diagnosis nudge
line: Check what caused a failure before editing.

beats.caption: The reminder asks the model to check its diagnosis.
beats.label: pi-diagnosis-nudge

beats.caption: The agent reads the helper to check the premise.

aside.title: What the model sees
aside.note: Captured from the failed tool result.

takeaway.title: Look at the cause
takeaway.line: One observation can narrow down why the check failed.

title.text: A failing test tells you something is wrong. You still need to find out what caused it.

scene.text: The shout test fails. Diagnosis nudge adds a reminder to the result, asking for evidence behind the suspected cause. The agent reads the helper and sees it ignores the option the test passes.

takeaway.text: Check the cause before you edit. That gives you a reason to expect your next change to help.
